title: Together Miniseries #1: We’re All In It Together
fullTitle: Soul Feast #31: Together Miniseries #1: We’re All In It Together
description: In this Soul Feast Gary shares a profound message about the unity of Life and the transformational journey humanity is undergoing. As the old world dissolves and a new one takes form, he reminds us that we are all part of something greater—a human family that is inseparable from all of Life.
Whether we recognize it or not, we are immersed in a global awakening, a shift from the pursuit of fear-based power toward the creation of authentic power rooted in the soul.
Gary distinguishes between the old and the new consciousness, and explains that half of humanity is now experiencing life as multi-sensory beings.
He explains that every moment —no matter how challenging or hopeful— is an invitation to choose love, compassion, and awareness . The key question becomes: Are we responding from love or fear?
It’s all about our choices! Our souls learn through choices, and our transformation begins within.
Please do not take anything that Gary or Linda share as true just because they say it. If it resonates with you, experiment with it in your life. If it doesn’t, let it go.

(00:45) — What it truly means to be “in it together”—and why it’s still true even if we no longer feel it (03:05) — The difference between the “little you” (personality) and the “large You” (soul) (05:52) — What defines the new consciousness—and why we are more than minds and bodies (08:54) — How some of us experience reality as multi-sensory and others do not yet (12:06) — How the chaos in the world reflects the contrast between the old and new consciousnesses (15:09) — Why young people today often operate from the new consciousness without needing to name it

Between now and the next episode, in a notebook/journal, write down the moments when you catch yourself seeking external power—through appearance, achievements, possessions, or influence. Ask yourself: Was I trying to manipulate or control this situation or someone else in order to feel safe and valued? What might love have chosen at this moment? This week, allow yourself to see clearly when you are acting from fear, and take one small step toward alignment with your soul.
Create the life you desire by choosing love over fear. Learn how HERE .
